paragraphs.text: Baron Von Count is a legendary Human Villain from Bablovia .

Baron Von Count is a member of the League of Dastardly Doom on Bablovia . He is part of the Legion of Evil, the ruling cabal that controls the League. He is a large human man who wears glasses and a blue jacket. He is associated with clocks and enjoys monologuing.
The Baron takes after classic monologuing villains — his name in design was Major Monologue — notably Lex Luthor and most James Bond villains.
